description: Use this when the user wants to draw names for a Secret Santa or gift exchange (secret santa generator, name draw, no email needed), including exclusions such as couples, households, "Ana can't draw Bo", or last year's pairs, an optional no 2-person loops rule, a budget, an exchange date, wish lists, and an organizer note. Returns one private reveal link per participant plus copy-ready messages; each pairing is encrypted inside the link, so the result never shows who drew whom. Explains exactly why when no valid draw exists. Handles 3 to 60 people. Does not send emails or texts and does not store anything. Do not use for White Elephant or Yankee Swap games (use plan_white_elephant) or for picking one random winner.

budget.description: Gift budget as the group says it, e.g. $30, 25 EUR, or £20-£25.

event_name.description: Name of the exchange shown on every link, e.g. Office Holiday Party 2026.

exchange_date.description: Gift exchange date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-18.

exclusions.description: One-way rules such as "Ana can't draw Cy" or last year's pairs, e.g. [{"giver":"Ana","cannot_draw":"Cy"}]. Cy may still draw Ana unless a second rule says otherwise.

cannot_draw.description: Whom the giver must not draw, e.g. Cy.

giver.description: Who must not draw the other person, e.g. Ana.

households.description: Couples or households whose members must not draw each other (both directions), e.g. [["Ana","Bo"],["Cy","Dee","Eli"]].

items.description: A participant's name exactly as listed in participants, e.g. Ana.

include_organizer_list.description: true only when the organizer explicitly asks to see every pairing; adds a link to the full list, which spoils the surprise for them. Default false.

language.description: Language of the reveal pages and share messages: en, es, fr, de, pl, pt, or ja (e.g. pl). Default en.

no_two_person_loops.description: true = never let two people draw each other (no A gives to B while B gives to A). Default false.

organizer_note.description: Optional note shown on every reveal page, e.g. Wrap gifts and bring them to the kitchen by 3 pm.

participants.description: Everyone taking part (3 to 60 people), e.g. ["Ana","Bo","Cy","Dee","Eli","Fay"]. Names must be unique; add a last initial to tell two people with the same name apart. Any language or script works.

wish_lists.description: Optional wish lists. Each one is shown only to the person who draws that participant.

name.description: A participant's name exactly as listed in participants, e.g. Ana.

wishes.description: Gift ideas shown to whoever draws this person, e.g. Board games, dark chocolate, no candles.

name: plan_gift_exchange
title: Plan Secret Santa draw
